title: Rider Pro D6 Black

specs.eps_liner_structure: Multi-Density Segmented EPS Matrix with Integrated Cooling Channels

description: Optimized for spirited canyon carvers and urban commuters alike, the Studds Rider Pro D6 Black is crafted for daily urban navigators conquering dense traffic. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell tips the scales at 1461g, channeling boundary-layer airflow to maintain a ~85 dB acoustic cabin profile while meeting DOT, ISI, ECE 22.05 impact standards. The interior leverages moisture-wicking antibacterial liners contoured for an Intermediate Oval fit, integrating eyeglass channels and track-proven Double D-Ring retention.

introduction: Positioned in Studds's Full Face lineup, the Rider Pro D6 Black brings Indian engineering to riders seeking balance between weight, cabin acoustics, and impact protection. Designed for an Intermediate Oval fitment, it connects daily usability with certified DOT, ISI, ECE 22.05 track safety.
story:
The Studds Rider Pro D6 Black represents Studds's dedicated protective engineering, incorporating aerodynamic shell sculpting and multi-density EPS impact damping. Its High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan shell dampens high-speed wind resonance while multi-density EPS channels absorb kinetic energy across direct and oblique impact vectors.

On the road, intake ports channel air across the scalp, keeping cabin noise around ~85 dB at 100 km/h. For riders seeking a High-Yield Impact-Resistant Polycarbonate / Lexan Full Face helmet tailored to an Intermediate Oval head shape, the Studds Rider Pro D6 Black delivers verified safety and long-distance rider comfort.
